debugData.name: Blender scatter (Points)
debugData.description: scatterTest's Geometry Nodes scatter (devTools/blender/buildScatterTest.py; p308 Phase 2) exported as a point cloud: the node ScatterPoints (custom prop aekScatterPoints) and its child, the points with _ROT, _SCALE and _ITEM, and the rocks' own nodes. Lossless: a scatter draws its items without their nodes, where a quantized encode puts its scale.
